clauses.reason: A SHOULD NOT that turns on the consumer a file is written for. No writer of the library, in Rust, Python or the C ABI, takes a consumer or a target version: the arguments name the destination, the frames, the float format or precision, compression, canonical order and the MPI settings, so no writer call states the clause.
A rule for revising the specification: adding a reserved section name raises con_spec_minor. It states nothing a reader or a writer does.
A rule for revising the specification: adding a reserved section name needs no new major. It states nothing a reader or a writer does.

A SHOULD on the values a producer stores. CON-section.19 forbids a reader to reject a frame whose energy differs from the sum of its energies rows, and tests/clause_coverage.rs::energy_that_differs_from_the_energies_sum_is_accepted reads such a frame.
